The upstream dual MIT/public-domain license is included verbatim in LICENSE and
in the headers. Package LICENSE with releases. No external image/font runtime
DLLs are needed; CDesktop compiles these sources. Only installed OS font files
are read. OS fonts are never copied into the repository or release package.
